title: Kee
desc: Siddharth, a hacker who is blessed with a happy family, falls in love with a girl. However, his life changes drastically when he becomes a victim of cyberbullying that leads him to another hacker.

title: Kanthaswamy
desc: Kanthaswamy, a CBI officer, conceals his identity by wearing a mask, in order to fight corruption and help people who need justice.

title: Naai Sekar Returns
desc: Naai Sekar, a small-time criminal, earns his living by kidnapping dogs belonging to wealthy people. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when Naai accidentally captures a wicked gangster's dog.

title: Jay Jay
desc: Jagan and Jamuna spend all day chatting on their first meeting. Jamuna puts down her details on a 100-rupee note declaring that if the note comes back to Jagan, then they are destined to meet.

title: Thillalangadi
desc: Nisha leaves Krishna because of his easy-going attitude towards life and career. Soon, her parents arrange her marriage to an honest policeman, but her life takes a turn when she chances upon Krishna.
